description: This file contains unit tests for the WindowPlacement utility, which manages window positioning logic in a macOS application. It tests functions like centeredFrame, topRightFrame, and ensureOnScreen to verify correct window placement behavior in various scenarios.

classes.name: WindowPlacementTests
classes.description: A test suite for window placement functions, utilizing the Testing framework for assertions.

methods.name: `centered frame zero bounds falls back to origin`
methods.description: Tests that the centeredFrame function returns a frame at origin when provided with zero bounds.

methods.name: `centered frame clamps to bounds and centers`
methods.description: Verifies that centeredFrame clamps to bounds and centers the window within given bounds.

methods.name: `top right frame zero bounds falls back to origin`
methods.description: Ensures topRightFrame returns at origin when bounds are zero.

methods.name: `top right frame clamps to bounds and applies padding`
methods.description: Checks that topRightFrame respects bounds and applies specified padding.

methods.name: `ensure on screen uses fallback when window offscreen`
methods.description: Tests that ensureOnScreen moves an offscreen window to the fallback position.

methods.name: `ensure on screen does not move visible window`
methods.description: Verifies that ensureOnScreen does not alter position of a window already on screen.
